correctness.rationale: Exact normalizer and exponential-family moments imply a strictly decreasing adjacent-mass ratio, hence variance below mean. The derivative numerator is a four-exponential polynomial with coefficient signs negative through degree 14 and positive from 15 onward, established by exact finite checks and an all-degree shifted-polynomial positivity certificate. This proves a unique global Fano minimum. Rational Taylor bounds certify rate and minimum. Differentiating the equimean zero-mass ratio gives (variance−mean)/rate<0 with limits one and one-half. The attached checker was rerun from its own actual file and passed all assertions; no finite sample is used as an infinite proof.
